name: Moped
description: A bicycle designed to be operated by human power with the assistance of a motor rated 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W) or less, with pedals that drive the rear wheel. A pedal e-bike over an electric bicycle's limits but under 1.5 brake horsepower lands here. It counts as a bicycle and isn't a motor vehicle.

restrictions.rule: Pedals that mechanically drive the rear wheel or wheels, and two or three wheels, one more than 14 inches in diameter (Maryland Transportation Article §11-134.1)
A motor rated 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W) or less (Maryland Transportation Article §11-134.1)
A bicycle, not a motor vehicle, under Maryland law (Maryland Transportation Article §11-104)
Riders need a driver's license of any class or a moped operator's permit
Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218, and the operator must wear approved eye protection unless it has a windscreen
Titled with the MVA, which issues a decal to display on it; the owner must certify at titling that it carries the required liability insurance
Must use a smooth-paved bike lane where there is one
Barred from roads posted above 50 mph except on their shoulders, and from expressways
